steps.code:
# Parse the old songs content into a list of (title, artists)
import re

content = _mem['s11']['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " by " to get title and artists
        if ' by ' in line:
            title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
        else:
            # No artists? Just title
            old_songs.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artists': []})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs:")
for s in old_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} by {', '.join(s['artists'])}")

    target_artists = set(a.lower() for a in song_info['artists'])
    for song in search_results:
